about: The Community Screensaver photo pool for Columbia County Live. Every entry runs in the screensaver's slow cycle with its credit line. Entries marked "starter": true are the seed pool — verified-license photographs already used elsewhere on the site. Community submissions NEVER land in this file directly: they arrive through the photo form, are reviewed by a person, and only approved photos are added here by hand (see DESIGN-SPEC.md, Community Screensaver section).
